findings.title: Deleted missing-data guard tests not restored
findings.problem: The diff removes the store tests 'fetchSessions keeps the store unchanged when the body has no data key' and 'fetchSessionDetail records nothing when the body has no data key'; the replacements always supply a `data` body, so the guards `if (data?.data) cliAnalyticsStore.sessions = data.data` and `if (!data?.data) return` (line 358) are unasserted.
findings.impact: Dropping either guard would assign undefined to sessions or throw on `detail.cost_incomplete` in fetchSessionDetail with no failing test. The guards are live on empty responses.
findings.recommendation: Restore both tests in src/store/__tests__/cliAnalytics.test.ts: respond with only metadata; assert sessions stays null and loading.sessions is false; assert sessionDetail has no entry for the trace id and its loading flag is reset.
